description: Feedback (background) chat parity, wave 4. Every expected value was produced by the TypeScript builder backgroundChatSlice.startFeedbackChat used before it moved onto start_chat_turn (steps 2-3 at f64d96ca43: the title cut and the _advisory first-turn input). src-tauri/src/commands/core/chat_turn.rs and src/stores/slices/agents/__tests__/chatTurnParity.test.ts both reproduce every case.

[feedback on report high-priority "Weekly digest"]

Too long, and lead with the risk.

## What I need from you
1. Acknowledge what the user pointed out.
